newsitem.title: ITALY: TENNIS-IN-FORM KUERTEN CHARGES INTO FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-IN-FORM KUERTEN CHARGES INTO FINAL.

text.p: French Open champion Gustavo Kuerten cruised into the final of the Bologna international clay-court tournament with a crushing victory over Italian Marzio Martelli on Saturday.
The 20-year old Brazilian, who is ranked 15 in the world after shooting up from 66th place following his French triumph, brushed aside his rival 6-1 6-2.
Last Sunday's surprise French Open winner wrapped up the first set in 22 minutes after Martelli made three double-faults.
Kuerten, the eighth seed, dominated from the baseline in a 50-minute duel on the sun-baked clay-court where temperatures touched 32 Celsius (90 Fahrenheit).
Wearing a black and silver bandanna, Kuerten exuded quiet confidence in contrast to the inconsistent Italian who sprayed many balls beyond the baseline.
Kuerten, who extended his winning run to 16 matches with Saturday's victory, will face either second seed Felix Mantilla of Spain or Moroccan sixth seed Karim Alami in Sunday's final.
